name: net_speaks_groundhold_at_the_causeway
description: The game asks for the subprotocol groundhold.v1 at the path /causeway: a typed LAN address, an online name and a bare ws:// URL all end at /causeway, and the wire's mode and Builder ids are the world's (high_water, tide_race, undertow; lookout) with their old numbers; a send is corked and uncorked and the comeback is the Seawall, in the contract and in the simulation's refusals, with the old numbers too.

steps.msg: a LAN address gets the port and the path
an online name gets wss and the path
a URL without a path gets the path

steps.assert: codec.spec()['modes']['classic']['id'] == 0 and codec.spec()['modes']['high_water']['id'] == 1 and codec.spec()['modes']['tide_race']['id'] == 2 and codec.spec()['modes']['undertow']['id'] == 3
steps.msg: the modes keep their numbers under the new ids
a send is corked and uncorked
the refusals say cork and Seawall: NO_CORKS_LEFT (7), NOTHING_CORKED (9), SEAWALL_STANDING (12)
